node.title: Re^3: My regex works, but I want to make sure it's not blind luck
node.author: GrandFather
node.doctext:
Have you a test case that fails? Why do you think "right to left" will fix the failing test case?

Note that you can reverse a string with [doc://reverse] then match against the reversed string. But that's only going to help if you can identify the problem you are trying to fix, and reversing the string somehow fixes that problem.

Optimising for fewest key strokes only makes sense transmitting to Pluto or beyond
